Proven track record in production support, troubleshooting, and major incident/root-cause analysis. Solid understanding of exception handling, resilience patterns, and operational controls. Working knowledge of API usage and integration concepts (REST, JSON, authentication basics). Strong analytical and communication skills—able to translate complex technical issues into clear actions and decisions. Exposure to AI/ML concepts or practical AIOps use cases. Experience leading data migration programmes (ETL, reconciliation, cutover). Python scripting and automation experience. Good to have - Experience modernising IBM i applications (service enablement, refactoring, hybrid integration). Familiarity with DevOps practices, version control (Git), and automated testing approaches.
